title: On a C¹-graph cylinder an integer multiplicity current has an integer-valued density on the graph
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k}, T ∈ 𝒟ₙ(U) and R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep) with R.Represents T. Let ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{n+k} be linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0, s, h > 0, z ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^k of class C¹ on D = B_s(0), Φ(v) := z + ιv + ι'u(v), Σ := Φ(D), C := {z + ιv + ι'w : ‖v‖ < s, ‖w‖ < h}. Assume C ⊆ U and spt μ_R ∩ C = Σ, where μ_R = R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M. Let ξ : ℝ^{n+k} → Λₙ(ℝ^{n+k}) and β : ℝ^{n+k} → Λⁿ(ℝ^{n+k}) be such that β is continuous on Σ, ξ(x)(β(x)) = 1 for every x ∈ Σ, and ξ(Φ(v)) is a unit orientation of range DΦ(v) for every v ∈ D. Then there is g : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ such that G := g∘Φ is locally integrable on D, G(v) ∈ ℤ for Lⁿ-a.e. v ∈ D, and T(ω) = ∫_Σ g(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with spt ω ⊆ C.
